categories.main_business_segments: Risen Energy primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of solar photovoltaic (PV) cells and modules. The company also operates in photovoltaic power station EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), power station operation, and energy storage systems. Additionally, it is involved in upstream materials like polysilicon and silicon wafers, as well as downstream applications including BIPV (Building Integrated Photovoltaics) and LED lighting products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced N-type solar cell technologies including HJT (Heterojunction), TOPCon, and XBC, with proprietary innovations such as 0BB cell technology, ultra-thin 210mm silicon wafers, and low silver consumption metallization. It employs smart manufacturing with digital twin systems, automated production lines, and advanced process controls to optimize efficiency and quality. Risen Energy also develops integrated energy storage solutions with proprietary BMS, PCS, and EMS systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Risen Energy serves global customers across approximately 90 countries, including major markets in China, the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, and Latin America. Its customers include solar power plant developers, commercial and residential rooftop users, and industrial clients requiring high-efficiency PV modules and energy storage solutions. The company also targets emerging applications such as PV+5G, PV+building integration, and PV+hydrogen production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases in China (Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Inner Mongolia), Malaysia, and Vietnam, with sales and service centers in Europe, North and South America, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Australia. It maintains a global footprint with subsidiaries and offices in key international markets to mitigate trade risks and support localized production and sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Risen Energy operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on solar cell and module manufacturing. It has vertically integrated upstream into polysilicon and silicon wafer production and downstream into PV power station EPC, operation, and energy storage system integration, forming a comprehensive end-to-end value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-efficiency N-type solar cells, especially heterojunction technology, and the industrialization of advanced PV products with lower LCOE and carbon footprint. It invests in smart manufacturing, digitalization, and automation to enhance production efficiency and quality. Risen Energy also focuses on expanding energy storage technologies and integrated PV+storage solutions, while exploring emerging applications like BIPV and PV+hydrogen.
categories.revenue_model: Risen Energy generates revenue mainly through the sale of solar cells and modules, EPC contracts for photovoltaic power stations, electricity sales from owned PV power plants, and sales of energy storage systems and related products. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Risen Energy is positioned as a global leader in the photovoltaic industry, particularly in high-efficiency N-type heterojunction solar cells and modules. It competes with other major global PV manufacturers and benefits from strong vertical integration and technological innovation. The company is recognized as a Tier 1 PV module manufacturer by BloombergNEF and holds significant market share in China and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Risen Energy reported revenues of approximately RMB 20.24 billion, a 42.7% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.44 billion. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 43.1 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.5 billion. Despite short-term profit declines due to market price pressures and asset impairments, the company maintains a large production capacity of 40GW for PV modules and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Risen Energy emphasizes its technological leadership in high-efficiency, low-carbon N-type heterojunction solar cells and modules with industry-leading conversion efficiencies exceeding 26%. Its products feature innovations such as ultra-thin wafers, low silver consumption, and stress-free interconnection technology, resulting in higher power output and lower LCOE. The company also offers integrated energy storage solutions with high safety and reliability, supported by a global manufacturing and service network, providing customers with comprehensive, high-value clean energy solutions.
